text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. These are errors that cause your program to behave in unexpected ways. To find them, you can use debugging tools such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution. A systematic approach is also helpful: check your code carefully, test one part at a time, and make changes gradually. Another useful technique is logging, which means adding print statements to see what your program is doing. By combining these strategies, you can solve problems faster and become a more confident developer.
